strings.allowedtypes_desc: Which types of recording can be made in the TinyMCE editor? In addition to this setting, there are capabilities which control access to recording options.
strings.audiobitrate_desc: Quality of audio recording (larger number means higher quality).
strings.audiotimelimit_desc: Maximum recording length for audio clips.
strings.discard_desc: There is a recording in progress. Do you want to stop the recording?
strings.gumabort: Something happened which prevented the webcam/microphone/screen from being used.
strings.gumnotallowed: You must allow the browser access to the webcam/microphone/screen.
strings.gumnotreadable: Something is preventing the browser from accessing the webcam/microphone/screen.
strings.gumnotsupported: Your browser doesn't support recording over an insecure connection.
strings.gumoverconstrained: The current webcam/microphone/screen can't produce a stream with the required constraints.
strings.gumsecurity: Your browser doesn't support recording over an insecure connection.
strings.gumtype: Tried to get stream from the webcam/microphone/screen, but no constraints were specified.
strings.insecurealert: Your browser might not allow this plugin to work unless it is used either over HTTPS or from localhost.
strings.maxfilesizehit: You have reached the maximum size limit for file uploads.
strings.norecordingfound: Something has gone wrong. Nothing has been recorded.
strings.nowebrtc: Your browser offers limited or no support for WebRTC technologies yet, and can't be used with this plugin. Please switch or upgrade your browser.
strings.privacy:metadata: The RecordRTC plugin does not store any personal data.
strings.recordagain_desc: You have already recorded some content. Recording again will remove this content. Are you sure you want to reset the recording?
strings.recordrtc:recordaudio: Record audio in the text editor
strings.recordrtc:recordscreen: Record screen in the text editor
strings.recordrtc:recordvideo: Record video in the text editor
strings.screenbitrate_desc: Quality of screen recording (a larger number means higher quality).
strings.screensharingstopped: You stopped sharing your screen before starting the recording. Please allow screen sharing in your browser settings and start the recording again.
strings.screensize_desc: The size of video output resolution.
strings.screentimelimit_desc: Maximum recording length for screen recording.
strings.timelimitwarning: You must enter a number that is greater than 0.
strings.videobitrate_desc: Quality of video recording (larger number means higher quality).
strings.videotimelimit_desc: Maximum recording length for video clips.
